effects.text: Regain all expended Actions. You lose an equal number of Actions on your next turn.

description.public:
Gadget · Engineer invention powered by Toolbelt scraps. Activate for 1 scrap; spend a 2nd scrap for the Toolbelt effect. Only Engineers gain the active benefit — an ally given this gadget gains only the Passive.

Free Action, 1/Safe Rest (1 scrap): Regain all expended Actions. You lose an equal number of Actions on your next turn.

Toolbelt (2 scraps): You no longer lose any Actions.

Passive: When Dying, your STR DC to use an Action is 8.

[A] Using the gadget spends 1 Toolbelt scrap and its 1/Safe Rest use — tracked on the sheet (click the counter to correct mistakes).

[A] Spends Elixir R's 1/Safe Rest use.

[A] The Toolbelt upgrade is the separate "Elixir R (Toolbelt)" feature (2 scraps total); the passive lives on the "Elixir R" gadget feature, so it works even if this item is unequipped.

[A] Keep the gadget equipped: Nimble switches off an unequipped object's rules, so its scrap cost would not be charged.

[M] Restore your spent Actions and remove the same number at the start of your next turn.
